study_status: Protocol fixed before new comparison outputs; extension of existing experiments, not a fresh-data confirmatory study.

fab.objective: Published leading-order FAB lower bound; constrained fixed-K adaptation; no ordinary-EM refit.
fab.model_selection: Native FAB objective, including across K for real datasets; BIC is an evaluation metric only.
fab.stopping_rule: Absolute objective change divided by training sample size <=1e-6 after a completed V/M cycle; at most30 V/M cycles following the initial weighted M step.
fab.adaptations: Fixed K, no component deletion; native bounded mixing weights and component domains; actual variational column masses in shrinkage; current-family feasible parameters retained; all13 family optimizations required. Native asymptotic regularity guarantees not asserted for all boundary/singular cases.

assignment_policy: Same score-maximizing assignment, weighted parameter start, numerical domain, deadlines and accepted pilot incumbents for all fixed-score methods.
tie_policy: Ranks break ties lexicographically. Cutoffs include all boundary ties within inherited 1e-10 tolerance. All-MVN compulsory; original accepted MVN/MVT starting models remain eligible. FAB family-score ties follow the frozen library order; its criterion differs from the fixed-score ranking.
cost_policy: Charge original measured table and complete-fit operation costs when reused; charge every new profile, fit, failed attempt and continuation. Cache lookup and HPC waiting are not fitting costs. Primary accounted time retains original table/candidate task elapsed costs and complete adaptive elapsed time. A second fitting_seconds measure removes separately measured candidate quality/restore overhead and uses adaptive weighted/complete operation times, with common table cost retained.
beam_policy: Search graph of unordered combinations differing in one family, ranked by accepted fitted BIC. No score-ranked beam. Every evaluated neighbour consumes budget, including unsuccessful fits.
benchmark_policy: Original complete-catalogue attained BIC for head-to-head cases; signed differences preserved. Also report common best observed BIC including adaptive outputs. Larger-K cutoff sensitivities use original partial comparisons only where applicable, and paired changes from cutoff2; no global optimum claim.
failure_policy: No dataset/seed replacement. Numerical failures/caps are retained. Missing/infrastructure results are separately flagged and never reported as completed scientific outcomes.
analysis_policy: Report paired BIC gaps (mean, median, quantiles, maximum, large-loss rates), fitting work and prediction. Average random-repeat outcomes within each dataset before summarizing or uncertainty calculation. Separate K3 complete benchmarks from K4/K5 partial benchmarks. No cutoff selected using test outcomes.
scope: Cutoffs: seven main simulation settings x50 plus20 H3 stress and3real datasets x4splits x3K=406. Alternatives: four K3 main settings x50 plus20 H3 stress plus36real tasks=256. Existing five-broad and Wholesale excluded consistently with current manuscript.
